up: Retrieve IC50 activity data for the compound with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL3183703 and all its salt forms (including the parent compound) against the target NACHT, LRR and PYD domains-containing protein 3 (ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1741208). Include the following columns: compound ChEMBL ID, compound name, canonical SMILES, IC50 standard value, IC50 standard units, IC50 standard relation, assay description, assay type, assay organism, PubMed ID, DOI, journal, and year. Do not impose any constraints on units, relation, or other fields; include all available IC50 measurements. Preserve all salt forms by using the molecule_hierarchy table (identifying compounds whose molregno is either the parent molregno or whose parent_molregno equals the parent molregno). Do not limit the number of returned rows.
sql:
WITH parent_molregno AS (
    SELECT molregno FROM molecule_dictionary WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3183703'
),
compounds AS (
    SELECT molregno FROM parent_molregno
    UNION
    SELECT mh.molregno FROM molecule_hierarchy mh
    WHERE mh.parent_molregno = (SELECT molregno FROM parent_molregno)
)
SELECT 
    md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    md.pref_name AS compound_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles,
    a.standard_value AS ic50_standard_value,
    a.standard_units AS ic50_standard_units,
    a.standard_relation AS ic50_standard_relation,
    ass.description AS assay_description,
    ass.assay_type AS assay_type,
    ass.assay_organism AS assay_organism,
    d.pubmed_id AS pubmed_id,
    d.doi AS doi,
    d.journal AS journal,
    d.year AS year
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid AND td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741208'
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.molregno IN (SELECT molregno FROM compounds)
ORDER BY md.chembl_id, a.standard_value;
